title: Closed skies are eating russian aviation’s profits
lead: russian airports shut 2,182 times this summer, more than in all of 2025. Even the government’s own estimate of the cost eats over half the industry’s RUB 31bn operating profit, while the state keeps handing airlines RUB 175bn in tax breaks.
imageAlt: Illustration: an airport apron at sunset, an airliner by the terminal and a CLOSED sign on a barbed-wire fence
